Community Plan Tracker

Students are lost between their first video and lesson 5. The plan invites plan holders who aren't in their city group chat into it during week one, and tests that with a randomized pilot. This page tracks the numbers behind that plan, by cohort month.

What this does and doesn't show

Both fields are student choices. Joining the chat has no date, so we can't tell if joining comes before progress or because of it. These gaps are correlation, not cause. The pilot is how we find out.

Pilot readout

Treatment vs control

Intent-to-treat: everyone assigned to outreach vs everyone in control, whether or not they replied or joined. Randomized 50/50 at entry.

Smallest lift the pilot can detect

Percentage points. α = 0.05 two-sided, 80% power, 50/50 split, lowest full month of volume.

A 3-month pilot on the segment only detects a large effect. Widening to all first-video students not in the chat is the recommended design, with plan holders pre-registered as the main subgroup.
